scenarios.title: A｜借电话
scenarios.setting: 玩家发现手机不见了，希望先给自己的号码打电话。

turns.text: Excuse me. I think I’ve lost my phone. Could I borrow yours for a moment?
Sure. Do you want to call your number?

turns.prompt: 关于「手机遗失」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: Yes, please. I want to see if someone answers.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, please. I want to see if someone answers.
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: Yes. I may have left it somewhere nearby.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I may have left it somewhere nearby.
feedback.explanation: “may have left”表示可能遗落了物品，地点尚未完全确定，语气保留了核实空间。

choices.text: Thanks. I just need to make a quick call.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I just need to make a quick call.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: I’d like to see if I can hear it ringing somewhere.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to see if I can hear it ringing somewhere.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Could you borrow me your phone?

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, please. I want to see if someone answers.
feedback.explanation: 请对方借出手机用“lend”；自己借入可以说“Could I borrow your phone?”。

turns.prompt: 关于「手机遗失」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks. I’ll only be a minute.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I’ll only be a minute.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: It’s ringing, but no one’s answering.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s ringing, but no one’s answering.
feedback.explanation: 先交代一部分情况，再补充限制或不同之处，避免对方只根据前半句作判断。

choices.text: It looks like the phone has been turned off.

feedback.naturalExpression: It looks like the phone has been turned off.
feedback.explanation: “looks like”根据眼前迹象作判断，给结论留有一点余地。

turns.text: Do you remember where you last had it?

turns.prompt: 对方在确认位置或去向，你会怎样说清楚地点？

choices.text: I think I last used it in the taxi.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I last used it in the taxi.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I had it at the café about an hour ago.

feedback.naturalExpression: I had it at the café about an hour ago.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: I’m not sure. I’ll need to retrace my steps.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure. I’ll need to retrace my steps.
feedback.explanation: 明确表达不确定，让对方知道需要进一步确认，而不是把猜测当作事实。

scenarios.title: B｜联系相关地点
scenarios.setting: 玩家怀疑手机落在刚才乘坐的出租车上，于是借电话联系出租车公司。

turns.prompt: 你想说明物品遗失或找不到的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: I think I left my phone in one of your taxis.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I left my phone in one of your taxis.
feedback.explanation: “I left my”谈随身物品时可表示遗落；接地点能说明东西可能在哪里。

choices.text: I took one of your taxis about an hour ago, and now I can’t find my phone.

feedback.naturalExpression: I took one of your taxis about an hour ago, and now I can’t find my phone.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: Could you help me contact the driver from my last trip?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you help me contact the driver from my last trip?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I’d like to report an item I may have left in a taxi.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to report an item I may have left in a taxi.
feedback.explanation: “may have left”表示可能遗落了物品，地点尚未完全确定，语气保留了核实空间。

choices.text: I forgot my phone on your taxi.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I left my phone in one of your taxis.
feedback.explanation: 手机落在出租车里用“left … in your taxi”，不说“on”车上。

turns.text: Do you have any information about the trip?

turns.prompt: 关于「手机遗失」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: I was picked up outside Central Station around 3 p.m.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was picked up outside Central Station around 3 p.m.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: I was dropped off at the Riverside Hotel.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was dropped off at the Riverside Hotel.
feedback.explanation: “was dropped off”表示被送到并下车，能说明出租车行程的终点。

choices.text: I paid by card. Would that help you find the trip?

feedback.naturalExpression: I paid by card. Would that help you find the trip?
feedback.explanation: “I paid”交代已使用的付款方式，方便查账或办理退款。

choices.text: I don’t know the car number, unfortunately.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t know the car number, unfortunately.
feedback.explanation: “I don't know”如实说明不清楚，避免把猜测说成确定的信息。

turns.prompt: 你想补充遗失物品的特征或可能遗落的位置，会怎么说？

choices.text: It’s a black phone with a clear case.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s a black phone with a clear case.
feedback.explanation: 给出颜色和物品特征，帮助工作人员把它与相似物品区分开，适合失物核对。

choices.text: There’s a small sticker on the back of the case.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s a small sticker on the back of the case.
feedback.explanation: 用具体规格或位置回应对方，便于落实选择；上下文已明确时，不必重复整项需求。

choices.text: The lock screen has a picture of a cat.

feedback.naturalExpression: The lock screen has a picture of a cat.
feedback.explanation: 描述锁屏照片这一可辨认特征，有助于工作人员确认是不是你的手机。

turns.text: We’ll contact the driver and call you back.

turns.prompt: 你想留下方便联系自己的方式或地点，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you call me at this number?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you call me at this number?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Thank you. I’ll be at my hotel for the next few hours.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I’ll be at my hotel for the next few hours.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Is there a reference number for the lost-item report?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a reference number for the lost-item report?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

scenarios.title: C｜解决网络 / 联系问题
scenarios.setting: 手机暂时找不回来，玩家没有移动网络，也无法查看后续行程信息。

turns.prompt: 你想说明物品遗失或找不到的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’ve lost my phone, and I need to get online somehow.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve lost my phone, and I need to get online somehow.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Could I use your Wi-Fi on my laptop?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I use your Wi-Fi on my laptop?
feedback.explanation: “Wi-Fi”指无线网络连接；可进一步区分连接不上和连接后无法上网。

choices.text: Is there a computer I could use for a few minutes?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a computer I could use for a few minutes?
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: I need to contact my family and check my travel bookings.

feedback.naturalExpression: I need to contact my family and check my travel bookings.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: I lost my phone, so I don’t have Internet now.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve lost my phone, and I need to get online somehow.
feedback.explanation: 这句能说明失去网络连接；若需要帮助，再补充借用设备或联系人的具体请求即可。

turns.text: You can use the guest computer in the lobby.

turns.prompt: 你想确认借用的网络能否完成所需联系或查询，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. Can I access my email from there?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Can I access my email from there?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Thanks. I need to check my flight information.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I need to check my flight information.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Would it also be possible to make an international call from the hotel?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it also be possible to make an international call from the hotel?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

choices.text: Could you help me write down the hotel’s phone number so my family can reach me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you help me write down the hotel’s phone number so my family can reach me?
feedback.explanation: “phone number”指电话号码，区别于手机本身。

turns.text: Of course. Here’s our phone number.

turns.prompt: 关于「手机遗失」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks. I’ll send it to my family from my email.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I’ll send it to my family from my email.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Great. At least they’ll have a way to contact me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. At least they’ll have a way to contact me.
feedback.explanation: “at least”表示最低数量或程度，能说明可接受的下限。

choices.text: Thank you. I’ll also try to secure my phone account while I’m online.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I’ll also try to secure my phone account while I’m online.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。
